how_to_apply: This recruitment does not use an online application portal. Candidates must apply offline, in person, by following these steps.
Download the application form from the official website, www.gmcnalgonda.in.
Fill in the application form completely in block letters, and paste a recent self-attested passport-size photograph in the space provided.
Attach one attested photocopy each of all the documents listed in the Documents Required section.

Submit the filled application, along with the Demand Draft for the application fee, at the Office of the Principal, Government Medical College, Nalgonda, between 05-09-2026 and 10-09-2026, on all working days up to 2:00 PM.
Retain a copy of the submitted application and keep original certificates ready for the certificate verification stage on 28-09-2026.
Incomplete applications will not be entertained.
important_instructions: This is a purely temporary, contract-basis appointment up to 31.03.2027, or till the actual need ceases, or till the regular posts are filled, whichever is earlier; it does not confer any right to future government appointment. Selected faculty are eligible for 15 days of leave per calendar year, on a cumulative basis. If a selected candidate does not join, the next eligible merit candidate will be selected. The selected candidate must submit a relieving order from their previous institute, failing which the selection stands cancelled. Candidates already working on contract in the same cadre at any other Government Medical College in Telangana are not eligible to apply. On selection, candidates must submit a bond on Rs.100 stamp paper, duly notarised, to the Principal, GMC Nalgonda. Breaking the bond requires paying three months' salary or giving one month's prior notice. The contract may be terminated at any time with one month's notice during the tenure period, if any misconduct is noticed. The engaged faculty will be at the disposal of the institute on a whole-time basis, and their services may be utilised in any manner required by the Competent Authority without additional remuneration claims. Wilful submission of wrong information is liable for criminal action; candidates must submit a self-declaration at the time of joining that no criminal cases are pending against them. Selected candidates must join duties within one week of selection. The decision of the selection committee is final and binding.

content_sections.heading: GMC Nalgonda Vacancy 2026 – Department-Wise Post Details
content_sections.text: GMC Nalgonda has announced 57 vacancies across Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Tutor, and Civil Assistant Surgeon posts, distributed over 12 departments. The department-wise breakup is given below. The notification also states that vacancy numbers may vary, decrease, or increase in accordance with administrative changes. Note: The notification also states that in the absence of MBBS doctors, candidates holding an M.Sc in Medical Anatomy, Biochemistry, Physiology, Microbiology, or Pharmacology with a Ph.D. will be considered.

content_sections.heading: GMC Nalgonda Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Eligibility differs by post, covering academic qualification, teaching/research experience, and medical council registration. For the Emergency Medicine department specifically, prior teaching experience in General Surgery, Anaesthesia, Respiratory Medicine, Orthopaedics, or General Medicine will be counted, and the selected faculty member must complete the prescribed faculty development programme within two years of appointment.

rows.qualification: MD/MS/DNB in the concerned subject, as per TEQ Regulation of NMC – 2022
rows.experience_requirement: 5 years post-PG experience, including 4 years as Assistant Professor in the subject at a permitted/recognized medical college; at least 2 research publications in Medline/PubMed/SCI/SCIE/EMBASE/Scopus/DOAJ-indexed journals; completion of the basic course in Medical Education Technology and the basic course in Biomedical Research, both from NMC-designated institutions

content_sections.heading: GMC Nalgonda Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: All posts require an MBBS degree as the base qualification, with Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts additionally requiring an MD/MS/DNB in the relevant subject as per NMC's TEQ Regulation 2022. Outside-state candidates must get their qualification registered with the Telangana State Medical Council within one week of selection for their appointment to be confirmed. DNB candidates will be selected as per the latest NMC guidelines.

content_sections.heading: GMC Nalgonda Age Limit
content_sections.text: Teaching posts (Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Tutor): below 69 years as on 31.03.2026 Non-teaching post (Civil Assistant Surgeon): below 45 years as on 31.03.2026 Retired teaching faculty of the Government of Telangana or other government bodies are not eligible for contract appointment Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. content_sections.heading: GMC Nalgonda Salary / Consolidated Pay
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be paid a fixed consolidated monthly remuneration as per G.O.Rt.No.98, Finance (HRM.VII) Department, dated 11.03.2024. The remuneration is all-inclusive and subject to tax deduction at source and other statutory deductions.

content_sections.heading: GMC Nalgonda Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates must pay an application fee of ₹500/- (non-refundable) for each application submitted, through a Demand Draft (DD) drawn in favour of the Principal, Government Medical College, Nalgonda.

content_sections.heading: GMC Nalgonda Selection Process
content_sections.text: For Assistant Professor posts: marks obtained in the MD/MS/DNB postgraduate degree For Tutor and CAS posts: marks obtained in the MBBS degree (if marks are not awarded in the qualifying exam, 50% marks will be considered) For Associate Professor posts: duration of teaching experience in that cadre Final selection is based on merit, duration of teaching experience, and interview Rule of Reservation will be followed wherever applicable For local candidature, Bonafide/Study conduct certificates from Class 1 to Class 7 will be considered Selection is nationwide, with first preference given to local candidates of Multizone-II for Assistant Professor, CAS, and Tutor posts; candidates from other states will be considered only if local candidates are not available

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for GMC Nalgonda Recruitment
content_sections.text: SSC Certificate / Birth Certificate (proof of age) Study/Bonafide Certificate (Class 1 to Class 7) MBBS Degree Certificate MD/MS/DNB/DM/MCH Certificate and Marks Memo MBBS Registration and additional registration with Telangana State Medical Council (outside-state candidates: registration within one week of selection) Experience certificates for all teaching appointments held Recent passport-size colour photograph Aadhar Card PAN Card Copies of publications with proof of indexation (for Associate Professor applicants) Community/Social Status Certificate / EWS / PH Certificate, as applicable For Assistant Professor: one-year Senior Resident completion certificate

Attach one attested photocopy each of all the documents listed in the Documents Required section. Submit the filled application, along with the Demand Draft for the application fee, at the Office of the Principal, Government Medical College, Nalgonda, between 05-09-2026 and 10-09-2026, on all working days up to 2:00 PM. Retain a copy of the submitted application and keep original certificates ready for the certificate verification stage on 28-09-2026. Incomplete applications will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. What is GMC Nalgonda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a contract recruitment drive by Government Medical College, Nalgonda, for 57 posts of Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Tutor, and Civil Assistant Surgeon, under Notification Rc.No.156/GMC/NLG/2026 dated 01-09-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in GMC Nalgonda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 57 vacancies in total: 11 Associate Professor, 26 Assistant Professor, 11 Tutor, and 9 Civil Assistant Surgeon posts, spread across 12 departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for GMC Nalgonda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 10-09-2026, up to 2:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for GMC Nalgonda Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need an MD/MS/DNB in the concerned subject as per NMC's TEQ Regulation 2022, along with one year as Senior Resident in the concerned subject at a recognized/permitted medical college.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for GMC Nalgonda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates for the teaching posts (Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Tutor) must be below 69 years as on 31.03.2026, while candidates for the Civil Assistant Surgeon (non-teaching) post must be below 45 years as on 31.03.2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for GMC Nalgonda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹500/-, non-refundable, payable by Demand Draft in favour of the Principal, Government Medical College, Nalgonda.

faq.question: Q7. Is the GMC Nalgonda Recruitment 2026 application process online or offline?
faq.answer: It is offline. Candidates must submit the filled physical application form with supporting documents at the Office of the Principal, GMC Nalgonda, between 05-09-2026 and 10-09-2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for GMC Nalgonda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on marks in the qualifying degree (MD/MS/DNB for Assistant Professor; MBBS for Tutor/CAS), teaching experience (for Associate Professor), and an interview, followed by certificate verification.
